description: Expressions of quantity, degree, or specificity; markers of conditional, causal, or comparative relationships; indicators of location and time; references to specific entities, places, or their attributes; and linguistic elements for emphasis or assertion

Detailed descriptions of specific products, services, or entities, outlining their features, capabilities, and attributes, often providing instructions for their use, management, or modification, alongside comparisons, technical specifications, or problem resolutions and status changes

Specific food and beverage items, their ingredients, preparation, and characteristics, along with the various contexts of their consumption, from health and personal choices to commercial and dining experiences
The explicit enumeration of details, specific instances, and conditions, as well as the logical and causal connections, within explanations of events, systems, or processes

Analysis of financial and economic data, encompassing monetary values, rates, percentages, and timeframes, within contexts of market dynamics, investment strategies, personal finance management, and regulatory oversight

Understanding the origins, underlying reasons, and contributing factors of various situations or personal experiences, and detailing the specific methods, strategies, or internal processes necessary for development, problem-solving, or achieving a desired outcome
Particular names, places, and times, characteristics, quantities, and the methods, purposes, or conditions of actions and states

The expression of inquiry, deliberation, or a search for understanding methods and purposes; specific identification of entities, numerical values, and temporal references; the articulation of capabilities, processes, and actions; the conveyance of strong emphasis, comparative evaluation, certainty, hope, or desire; and the signaling of conditional, causal, negative, or limiting relationships
Specific characteristics of objects and methods, including instructional sequences, evaluative feedback, and markers of certainty or time
